items.text: Our paper on microrobot is accepted to Science Advances. Congrats!
Byun lab welcomes new members Dr. Sung Yol Yu (postdoc), Seungwon & Hyunjin (graduates), Jino & Boae (interns). Welcome!
Dr. Junghyeon Ko's paper on wound contraction adhesive materials is accepted to Advanced Functional Materials. Congrats!
Jaeyoung joined our group. Welcome!
Byun lab welcomes new undergraduate interns Junhyeong & Seungwon. Welcome!
Dr. Byeonghak Park receives Sejong Science Fellowship, congrats!
Dr. Byeonghak Park receives NRF Postdoc Fellowship, congrats!
Our contributing paper on zero-Poisson's ratio soft mechanical metamaterials is accepted to Advanced Functional Materials.
Byun lab welcomes a new visiting scholar M.D. Sejin Choi (SNU hospital). Welcome!
Dr. Junghyeon Ko receives Sejong Science Fellowship, congrats!
Byun lab welcomes new postdocs, Dr. Byeonghak Park & Dr. Junghyeon Ko. Welcome!
Our paper on mechanical computing is accepted to Nature Communications. Congrats!
Byun Lab welcomes new graduate students, Wonkyeong & Hoyoung. Welcome!
Our contributing paper on hydrogel metasurfaces is accepted to Nature Communications.
Our contributing paper on magnetic putty is accepted to Advanced Materials.
Bio-Interactive Robotics Lab (BIRLab) is opened.
Dr. Byun joined the Soft Hybrid Materials Research Center, Korea Institute of Science and Technology (KIST), Korea, as a Senior Research Scientist.
Our paper on reconfigurable innervation of modular soft machines is accepted to Advanced Intelligent Systems.
Dr. Byun got awarded a Sejong Science Fellowship from the Ministry of Science and ICT, Korea.
Our paper on deployable soft origami modular robotic arm is accepted to IEEE-RAL.
Our paper is issued in Advanced Materials Technologies as a front cover article.
Our paper on underwater swimming robotic sheets is accepted to Science Robotics.
Our paper on 4D printing is accepted to Advanced Materials Technologies.
Dr. Byun got awarded a Humboldt Research Fellowship.
Dr. Byun got awarded a Postdoc Fellowship for Basic Science Research Program from the NRF Korea.
